---
title: "90-Day Health Analysis"
output: html_document
---
## setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
dir()
setwd("C:/Users/user/OneDrive/Desktop/health_project")
getwd()
dir()
health_raw <- read_excel("health_data.xlsx")
health_raw
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
install.packages("janitor")
library(janitor)
#Create a clean working dataset
health <- health_raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    weekday = wday(date, label = TRUE),
    is_weekend = weekday %in% c("Sat", "Sun")
  )

glimpse(health)
# Data summary
health |>
  summarise(
    days = n(),
    start_date = min(date),
    end_date = max(date),
    missing_steps = sum(is.na(steps)),
    missing_sleep = sum(is.na(sleep_hours))
  )
#first plot, steps over time
ggplot(health, aes(x = date, y = steps)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point()
#second plot sleep over time
ggplot(health, aes(x = date, y = sleep_hours)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()
#Compare weekdays vs weekends
health |>
  group_by(is_weekend) |>
  summarise(
    avg_steps = mean(steps, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_sleep = mean(sleep_hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    days = n()
  )
#Visual comparison
#steps
ggplot(health, aes(x = is_weekend, y = steps)) +
  geom_boxplot()
#sleep
ggplot(health, aes(x= is_weekend, y = sleep_hours)) +
  geom_boxplot()
#Relate sleep and steps
ggplot(health, aes(x = sleep_hours, y = steps)) +
  geom_point()
#Add a trend line
ggplot(health, aes(x = sleep_hours, y = steps)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
#Scatter plot split by weekend
ggplot(health, aes(x = sleep_hours, y = steps, color = is_weekend)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
#add title and lable x and y axis
ggplot(health, aes(x = sleep_hours, y = steps, color = is_weekend)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    color = "Weekend?",
    x = "Sleep hours",
    y = "Daily steps",
    title = "Relationship between sleep and steps by day type"
  )
#Resting Heart Rate
ggplot(health, aes(x = date, y = resting_hr)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()
#Steps vs Resting Heart Rate
ggplot(health,aes(x = steps, y = resting_hr, color = is_weekend)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Steps and Resting Heart Rate",
    x = "steps",
    y = "resting_hr",
    color = "is_weekend?"
    
  )
